observations: Silver countertop microwave oven with control panel on the right side

Control panel has push buttons and a rotary dial, but labels are not legible
No readable brand name or model number visible on the exterior
Unit appears used and is sitting on a surface with other items nearby

risks.risk: Grill function is missing or defective
risks.proof: Close-up of the control panel showing a grill button or symbol, plus a demo of grill operation

risks.risk: Brand and model unknown, affecting resale value
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rating plate or brand badge

proof_requests: Clear photo of the brand badge or rating plate
Video of the microwave running with water inside to confirm it heats
Close-up of the control panel to confirm grill function exists
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a countertop microwave oven even without a readable brand, so it can be priced at its worst case: not working, microwave-only, generic unit.
